_doc: THE PIANO SOLO'S UNITS, taken one by one at his word (RUNNING_LOG §255 on). A unit = the notes on ONE stem. stem up|down · flag 16 · arp true = the arpeggio line · beam <name> = beamed (16th) to the other units of that name. · at <seconds> = the unit is drawn at that time instead of its own. · sg <name> = a SCATTERED GRACE (§263): the units of that name are one figure in two hands, drawn at even distances across its span; played = the unit's played time(s), the record of its rhythm. · spread right|both = a beamed group at equal distances for fit (§262 · §265): right = the first unit stays on its played place.
